basics.heading: What exosomes are
paras: Exosomes are microscopic vesicles that cells use to send signals. They carry proteins, growth factors, cytokines and genetic material. Research is ongoing into whether these signals can calm inflammation and support repair.
The exosomes come from donated, screened human mesenchymal stem cells and contain no living cells. They can be given by IV infusion or injected directly into a treatment area.
Exosome therapy is not a cure and is not FDA-approved for any condition. Dr. Khan uses it to help reduce symptoms and support recovery as part of a broader plan with your other doctors.
